title: Gaon ki Beti Yojana 2026: Form, Last Date, ₹500/Month
meta_description: Gaon ki Beti Yojana MP: ₹500/month for 10 months for rural girls with 60% in Class 12. Form on scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in with Samagra ID. Full steps inside.

hero.one_liner: MP pays village girls ₹500 a month through graduation for scoring 60% in Class 12. The form is online and free.

what_is_it: Gaon ki Beti Yojana is Madhya Pradesh's scholarship for girls from villages who clear Class 12 in first division. The Higher Education Department pays ₹500 a month for 10 months of every college year.
Girls in technical and medical courses get a higher rate of ₹750 a month. The money goes by DBT to the student's own bank account, every year of the course.

The scheme's logic is blunt and correct: the first girl from a village family to reach college usually quits over small monthly costs, not big fees. This stipend covers exactly those costs, bus fare, copies, and forms.

Around 2005, when the scheme began, a village girl in college was rare enough to make local news. Twenty years and lakhs of beneficiaries later, the ₹500 keeps doing quiet work that big schemes cannot.

eligibility.label: Who can apply
eligibility.value: Girl students who are permanent residents of a rural area of Madhya Pradesh. Urban MP girls are not covered, this scheme is village-only.

eligibility.label: Marks requirement
eligibility.value: Class 12 passed with 60% or more (first division) from any recognised board. The percentage rule has no category relaxation.

eligibility.label: Study requirement
eligibility.value: Admission in a graduation course, regular technical, medical, or any degree stream, in a government or recognised private college.

eligibility.label: Key certificate
eligibility.value: The Gaon ki Beti certificate (village daughter praman patra), which verifies you studied from the village. Without it the form does not complete.

extra_sections.heading: Gaon ki Beti at a Glance
Running Since 2005: Why This Scheme Survived Every Government
content: Gaon ki Beti started in 2005 and has outlived four governments of both parties. Schemes with that survival record share one trait: they are cheap for the state and life-changing for the beneficiary.
The design explains it. ₹5,000 a year per girl is a rounding error in a state budget, but it is two months of a farm family's spare cash.
Two decades in, the scheme's real product is normalisation. In thousands of villages, a daughter going to college stopped being an event and became a plan.
For you, the age of the scheme means process maturity. Colleges know the verification drill, and the portal handles it as a routine annual cycle, not an experiment.

extra_sections.title: 📌 Form & Last Date Status (Verified 31 July 2026)
extra_sections.content:
Applications run online on scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in along with the college admission season. No separate last date for 2026-27 has been officially announced yet, the portal shows the live window.

Ignore websites publishing exact last dates without a source, they are guessing for clicks. When the official date appears, this block will carry it.

The form is free. Fill it yourself or at a computer centre, no agent is needed anywhere in the process.

extra_sections.heading: The Form PDF Confusion, Cleared
content: Thousands search for a Gaon ki Beti form PDF every month, and the honest answer is that no PDF form exists anymore. The application is fully online.
The PDF era ended when MP moved scholarships to the State Scholarship Portal. Anyone selling or emailing you a form PDF is wasting your time at best.
What you do need on paper is the Gaon ki Beti certificate from your school or panchayat side. That physical certificate gets scanned and uploaded into the online form.
So the correct search is not form PDF, it is portal registration. The steps below walk through exactly that.
Old PDF forms from 2019-2022 still float around on download sites. Submitting one anywhere achieves nothing, the department only reads the portal queue.

extra_sections.heading: First Time on the Portal: What the Registration Actually Asks
content: The registration page asks for three identities: Samagra member ID, Aadhaar number, and a working mobile for OTP. The names on all three must match letter for letter.
A mismatch between Samagra and Aadhaar spelling is the most common first-day failure. Fix the Samagra record at your Gram Panchayat before retrying, Aadhaar corrections take longer.
The portal creates one student profile that serves every MP scholarship, not just this one. Fill the profile carefully once and future scheme forms pre-fill from it.
Use your own mobile number, not a cyber cafe's. Every future OTP, status alert, and correction request routes to that number for years.

extra_sections.heading: What You Get: Course-wise Amounts
The Village Daughter Certificate: The Step That Delays Everyone
content: The Gaon ki Beti praman patra is the scheme's gatekeeper document. It certifies you actually studied as a village student, and no other paper substitutes for it.
Get it issued from the school where you passed Class 12, countersigned as per the district's practice. Some districts route it through the principal, others involve the local body.
Apply for it the week your result comes, not the week the scholarship form opens. Certificate delays are the single biggest reason first-year girls miss the window.
Keep two attested copies and one scan. The same certificate serves every renewal year, so it is a one-time chore.

extra_sections.heading: From Which Village Counts: Residence Questions Answered
content: The scheme reads rural through your residence and schooling, which raises real edge cases every admission season. The certificate process is where they get resolved.
Studied in a town school while living in the village? Districts differ on this case.
The certificate authority's decision is what stands, so ask your school first, it has processed dozens of such cases.
Family shifted to the city after your Class 12? Your claim rests on the village schooling already completed, so apply with the certificate from the village school.
Panchayat area recently merged into a municipality? Take the issue to the college scholarship cell with your certificate, boundary-change cases are decided on documents, not portal dropdowns.

extra_sections.heading: How the 10 Months Are Counted
content: The stipend runs for 10 months a year, not 12, because it maps to the academic session. Vacation months are excluded by design.
Disbursement rarely lands as neat monthly credits. In practice, sanctioned amounts often arrive in consolidated instalments during the session, depending on when your verification completed.
So a ₹2,500 lump credit mid-session is normal, it is five months together. Match the total against ₹5,000 or ₹7,500 for the year, not against a monthly rhythm.
Keep your own tally in the passbook. If the session ends short of the full amount, the college cell reconciles it against your sanction record.

extra_sections.heading: Can You Stack It With Other Scholarships?
content: Gaon ki Beti sits in a sweet spot: it is a merit-cum-residence award, not an income-tested one. That changes what it combines with.

Girls eligible for post-matric scholarships (SC, ST, OBC) generally receive both, since post-matric is category-based and this is residence-based. Confirm the combination on the portal, rules get refined year to year.
MMVY is the big-fee scheme for 70%+ scorers, and it explicitly targets tuition, not living costs. Many toppers from villages hold MMVY for fees and Gaon ki Beti for the monthly stipend.
Pratibha Kiran is this scheme's urban sister for city girls from poor families. You qualify for one or the other, never both, residence decides it.

extra_sections.heading: Renewal: How the Money Continues in 2nd and 3rd Year
content: The scholarship is not one-time, it runs through your course, but the portal does not renew it for you. Every session needs a renewal application.
Renewal asks for two proofs: your promotion to the next year and a fresh college bonafide. The village daughter certificate from year one carries forward.
File the renewal as soon as the new session's window opens. Renewals compete with fresh applications for college verification time, and late files slip into the next disbursement batch.
A failed year pauses the scholarship for that year. It resumes on promotion, so one bad exam season does not end the support permanently.

extra_sections.heading: Status Check and Common Stuck Points
content: Track your application from the same portal login, the dashboard shows each stage from submission to sanction. The most common stuck stage is college verification.
If the status sits at institute level for weeks, visit your college scholarship cell with your application number. Files move the day someone asks in person.
Payment sanctioned but bank empty? That is Aadhaar seeding, ask your bank to confirm NPCI DBT mapping on your account.
Wrong bank details entered in the form is the third classic. Correct them through the portal's edit window or the college cell before the disbursement run.
Save a screenshot of every status change with the date visible. If a dispute ever reaches the department, a dated trail settles it in minutes.
The portal helpdesk email and the college cell are your two escalation lanes. Use the college first for verification issues and the portal for technical form errors.

extra_sections.heading: Own Bank Account: The Small Rule That Trips Minors
content: The account must be in the student's own name, not a parent's. Girls who turn 18 during first year often still carry a minor account opened years ago.
Convert the minor account to a regular one at the branch with Aadhaar and PAN, or open a fresh zero-balance account. Both work, conversion is usually faster.
Then get the account Aadhaar-seeded through NPCI for DBT, which is a separate step from KYC. Say the word NPCI at the counter, it avoids the usual confusion.
Do this before filling the form, not after sanction. Changing bank details mid-process is the slowest correction in the whole pipeline.

extra_sections.text: Sixty percent from a village school is a bigger achievement than ninety from a city coaching hub. This scheme is MP admitting exactly that.

extra_sections.title: Scholarship 2.0 Confusion
extra_sections.content:
Searches for Gaon ki Beti Scholarship 2.0 spike every season. There is no separate 2.0 scheme, the name comes from MP's State Scholarship Portal 2.0, the platform the form lives on.

Same scheme, same amounts, upgraded portal. Anyone marketing a new 2.0 scheme with different benefits is misleading you.

extra_sections.heading: A Realistic Budget: What ₹500 a Month Actually Does
content: ₹500 does not pay a hostel, and pretending otherwise helps nobody. What it pays is the daily leak that makes families question a daughter's college: bus fare, photocopies, practical files, form fees.
For a girl commuting from the village to a nearby government college, monthly costs sit right in this band. The stipend converts college from a cost argument into a free habit.
Girls moving to a city for a technical seat should stack schemes: MMVY or post-matric for the fees, this for pocket costs, and the college's own aid for hostel.
The families that make it work treat the stipend as the daughter's own money for her study costs. That single household rule predicts completion better than any scheme design.

extra_sections.heading: Advice for Parents Reading This
content: If you are a father or elder brother checking whether this scheme is real: it is, it is two decades old, and it costs nothing to claim.
The whole process needs no travel beyond the school and the college, and no payment to anyone. A daughter with a phone can do the form herself in an hour.
The bank account must be in her name, and that is a feature, not a formality. Money she manages for her own education is the scheme working as designed.
One practical role fits you perfectly: be the person who remembers the renewal each year. That single reminder is worth the entire three-year payout.
If the certificate office asks why the scheme needs it, the answer is one line: it proves village schooling, which is the scheme's entire basis. Offices process it faster when the purpose is clear.

faqs.question: Gaon ki Beti Yojana form kaise bharein?
faqs.answer:
Form scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in par online bharte hain. Samagra ID se register kariye, scheme chuniye, documents upload kariye aur submit.

Koi PDF form nahi hai aur koi fees nahi lagti. College verification ke baad paisa DBT se aata hai.

faqs.question: Gaon ki Beti Yojana 2026 last date kya hai?
faqs.answer:
2026-27 session ki official last date abhi announce nahi hui hai. Application window admission season ke saath portal par chalti hai.

Bina source ke exact date batane wali websites par bharosa mat kariye. Portal par live window hi final hai.

faqs.question: Kitna paisa milta hai is yojana mein?
faqs.answer:
Regular graduation courses mein ₹500 mahina, saal ke 10 mahine, yaani ₹5,000. Technical aur medical courses mein ₹750 mahina, yaani ₹7,500 saal ka.

Paisa har saal milta hai, course ke पूरे duration tak, renewal karne par.

faqs.question: Gaon ki Beti certificate kahan se banta hai?
faqs.answer:
Jis school se aapne 12th pass ki, wahan se village daughter praman patra banta hai. District ke hisaab se principal ya local body countersign karti hai.

Result aate hi banwa lijiye, form ke time ki bhaag-daud sabse zyada isi certificate mein hoti hai.

faqs.question: Kya 60% se kam marks par apply kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer:
Nahi. 60% (first division) is scheme ki hard condition hai aur ismein koi category relaxation nahi hai.

60% se kam par doosri scholarships dekhiye, jaise category-based post-matric schemes.

faqs.question: What is Gaon ki Beti Scholarship 2.0?
faqs.answer:
There is no separate 2.0 scheme. The name refers to MP's State Scholarship Portal 2.0, the upgraded platform where the same form now lives.

Amounts and eligibility are unchanged, only the portal got a version number.

faqs.question: City ki ladkiyon ke liye kya option hai?
faqs.answer:
Urban girls Gaon ki Beti mein eligible nahi hain. Unke liye MP ki Pratibha Kiran scholarship hai, jo sheher ki economically weaker families ki betiyon ke liye hai.

Dono mein se ek hi milti hai, residence decide karta hai.

faqs.question: Kya Gaon ki Beti aur post-matric scholarship saath mil sakti hai?
faqs.answer:
Aam taur par haan, kyunki post-matric category-based hai aur yeh residence-plus-merit based. Kai students dono paati hain.

Portal par combination rule confirm kar lijiye, kyunki niyam session ke saath refine hote rehte hain.

faqs.question: Paisa kab aana shuru hota hai?
faqs.answer:
College verification aur sanction ke baad, session ke months ke hisaab se DBT credit shuru hota hai. Status portal dashboard par har stage dikhta hai.

File institute level par atki ho toh college scholarship cell mein application number ke saath miliye.
